name: VolunTeens
what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about conservation. Teens volunteer all year on school holidays, breaks and some Saturdays (not in summer). A 1-day training is required.
how_to_apply: Fill out the VolunTeens Application linked on the zoo's support page. Group questions: volunteer@fcz.org.
notes: Fresno is in the Central Valley, outside Merced County. The page uses one application link for both VolunTeens and the junior camp counselor role.
